sources.entry: BetterZip - Archive tool supports ZIP, TAR, TGZ, TBZ, TXZ (new), 7-ZIP, RAR.

summary.name: BetterZip 6
summary.one_liner: BetterZip 6 is a Mac archiver for creating, editing, and extracting ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR, DMG and many other archive formats.
use_cases: Compress files into ZIP, 7z, or TAR archives on a Mac
Extract RAR, 7z, or other archives on macOS
Add, delete, or rename files inside an existing archive
Encrypt archives with AES-256 and manage passwords
Strip .DS_Store and other clutter from archives before sharing
Preview archive contents in Finder with Quick Look
summary.what_it_does: BetterZip creates archives in formats including ZIP, DMG, TAR, TGZ, TBZ, TXZ, Zstandard, Brotli, 7-Zip, XAR and ISO, and uses an external command-line utility for RAR. It can modify archives in place by adding, deleting, renaming or editing items, and can open and extract over 30 formats, including joining split files and editing ePub files. Presets store destination, format, encryption, filters, renaming rules and optional post-processing actions, and can be run from menus, Finder, Shortcuts, Automator or the command line. Filters match by name, path, size and age, and a Quick Look extension previews archive contents in Finder without launching the app.
notable: Preset system that captures format, encryption, filters, renaming and post-processing actions, reusable from menu, Finder, Shortcuts or CLI
Quick Look extension that previews archives in Finder, free for everyone
AppleScript, Shortcuts, Automator and CLI automation support
Built-in encrypted password vault and AES-256 encryption
caveats: Requires a license after a 30-day full-featured trial; the page advertises no subscription
RAR creation depends on an external command-line utility
